Name: TP-TASK-001
Precondition: User is on TP home page.
Objective: Validate that the user can successfully create a checklist
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Navigate to Menu -> Training Plans & Checklist > Generic
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re:
1. Training Plans & Checklist  page is opened
   2. Add New Module button is available

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Click on Create New Plan button
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Create New Plan modal is opened

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step:
Fill the test data:
   1. Team
   2. Due Period (Days)
   3. Description
   4. Recurrence (Days - 0 for non-recurrent plans)
   5. Ducument title
   6. Priority
   7. Target Audience
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Test Data:
1. test data : Team
   2. test data : Due Period
   3. test data : Description
   4. test data : Recurrence (Days - 0 for non-recurrent plans)
   5. test data : Ducument title
   6. test data : Priority
   7. test data : Target Audience

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: The Add New Task button is displayed.
A new task entry form is displayed.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step:
Fill the test data:
   1. Task Name.
   2. Task Description.
   3. Hours and Minutes.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Test Data:
1. Task Name
   2. Task Description
   3. Hours and Minutes

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: The task is added to the task list with the entered details.
All tasks are saved successfully and a confirmation message is displayed.

A popup is displayed with the message: "Success! Training Plan: [Document 
Title] is saved".

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Click Close on success message popup

Click on Created/Updated to sort/filter the module list by the latest check 
date.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re:
The module list is updated, and the most recently created module is 
displayed as the first item in the list.
